pages.summary: Canonical adversarial red-team testing framework for sovereign AI. 12 named attack vectors (prompt injection → supply chain → SIGIL integrity) × 5 severity tiers (T1-Cosmetic → T5-Catastrophic) × automated continuous + manual pre-deployment cadence. Cross-walked to UK AISI Pre-Deployment Evaluation, EU AI Act Art-15/55, NIST AI RMF M2.7, ISO 42001 A.7, OWASP LLM Top-10 (2025), NCSC CAF C4. 3-tier independence (internal → external accredited → BFT-supervised). 240+ automated adversarial prompts. T4/T5 findings trigger NCSC + UK AISI mandatory disclosure + BFT emergency session.

Return-on-investment model for DEFONEOS sovereign-AI pilots in UK public services and defence. 3 scenarios (Constrained £0 / Base £25k / Accelerated £100k) × 12-month horizon × 5 cost categories × 7 benefit streams × HM-Treasury Green Book (2022) NPV/IRR/BBC methodology. Buyer-specific calibrations for MOD (£847k 12-mo NPV, 4.2mo payback), NHS (£1.2M, 2.8mo), Local Authority (£432k, 6.1mo), FCDO (£680k, 3.9mo). 3.5% discount rate. Sensitivity analysis across 6 variables. Green Book five-case alignment. 10 named assumptions with sources.

Plain-English explainer of AUKUS Pillar II and DEFONEOS sovereign AI alignment. 8 workstreams × 4 direct alignments (AI, Cyber, EW, Info Sharing) + 4 indirect (Quantum, Undersea, Hypersonics, Defence Innovation). £180M FY26-30 UK trilateral addressable + £310M Five Eyes bilateral = £490M total. 57.5% annex coverage (23/40 deliverables). 7 sovereignty questions answered. AUKUS-compatible but NOT AUKUS-dependent. No US CLOUD Act exposure. No fifth-eye dependency. Section 7 OSA compliant. 6 AUKUS-specific red lines.
